description: Echo main window — minimal-viable permissions. No shell, fs, sql, opener, dialog, process or network permission: the WebView communicates only via explicit Tauri commands/events, cover:// for cover art, and core window introspection getters. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is the one exception: macOS runs this window with `titleBarStyle: Overlay` + `hiddenTitle`, so no native titlebar drags it and the top inset strip must ask the window to drag itself.
